data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'Chabakah', meaning 'Young Goat'. This name is a symbol of strength, courage, and determination. It is often given to children born during the spring season, as it is associated with the rebirth and renewal of nature. The name Chabuk carries the meaning “Young Goat” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Pashto. Parents who choose Chabuk usually hope their child will grow to embody young goat and live with faith, good character and purpose.

It is believed to represent the purity and innocence of a young goat, as well as the strength and determination of an adult goat.
data.etymology: Chabuk belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Young Goat.”
